chapter.title: Native connected sessions: durable actions and bounded provider journeys
guidance: Every real native picker, composer, live event, stop, goal and read action passes its host observer before the client receives the result.

The startup self-check uses actual backend dispatch, orchestration, SQLite persistence, broker registry/event ledger and chat-run control with a finite provider on explicit loopback port48468. It opens no saved account or credential files.
Owned child processes establish cancellation receipts and retry after actual not_running; a missing confirmation receipt must remain interrupted with an explicit warning.

pitfalls.failure: A model stream may replace an earlier response or emit private reasoning.
pitfalls.recovery: Keep the same answer identity/slot, clear its prior draft for a new response identity and ignore non-public reasoning sources.

pitfalls.failure: A stop request can arrive before the backend registers its turn.
pitfalls.recovery: Retain the unacknowledged stop and retry until the actual owner registers and acknowledges it.

frontier: Real provider accounts, installed CLIs, backend constructor/login initialization, completion push delivery and rendered UI are outside the finite provider boundary.
Unconfirmed cancellation deliberately withholds the transport termination receipt even though its confined child is reaped; the adapter must report uncertainty rather than claim confirmed stopping.
